description: Searches all tools of the AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank (KULIC Advisory) by task, keyword or tool name, in German or English, and returns the best matches with name, tool number, section (one of eight), purpose and input fields. Can also list one of the eight sections. This endpoint lists only a core set; use find_tool when no listed tool fits, then call the match with run_tool (or directly by name if your client allows it). Open without sign-in, stores nothing.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

query.description: What the user wants to do, e.g. 'supplier changed bank account', 'Skonto', 'SLA', 'compare offers'. May be empty when a rubric is given.

rubric.description: Optional section of the Werkbank: 1 invoices and finance, 2 quotes and buying, 3 contracts and deadlines, 4 suppliers and risk, 5 orders and approvals, 6 steering and numbers, 7 team and knowledge, 8 processes and AI. With an empty query it lists the whole section.

name: find_tool
title: Find the right AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank tool for a task
